test_cases.name: init_gateway_before_shots
test_cases.input: Resume cinematic development. Create the Solari Cinematic Gateway for Birth of the Sunwell.
assertions: Writes a tension model before any shot list
Emits a Gateway Package with goldenMaster.lockPrompt
Runs init_gateway.py or equivalent JSON with sacredSource the Sunwell
Hands boarding to cinematic-storyboard with a legal ladder

test_cases.name: expand_panel_5_keeps_sunwell
test_cases.input: Expand this storyboard panel: PANEL 5 BIRTH OF THE SUNWELL, Wide Establishing Shot, 24mm anamorphic slow clockwise orbit.
assertions: Treats the panel as one ES (rung 0) with an in-shot orbit, not extra fake cards
Keeps the word Sunwell; does not rename it Dawnwell
Strips captions, timecode, and SHOT TYPE from generated pixels
Builds a lead-in walk and a release; any smash back to ES is ruleBreak with a manifestation reason

test_cases.name: ip_scan_blocks_franchise_cast
test_cases.input: Use Sylvanas and Kael'thas at the Sunwell in Silvermoon.
assertions: Does not use Sylvanas, Kael'thas, or Silvermoon in lockPrompt or shot action
Rewrites to Solari / Dawnspire original names and says so

test_cases.name: golden_master_must_validate

assertions: Fills all required Golden Master fields including identityLock.eyes and lockPrompt

test_cases.name: defers_plain_storyboard
